# Superflat

Superflat strips away UI clutter for a distraction-free workspace. Borders, scrollbars and visual depth are hidden, and status bars, sidebars and tab headers are revealed only on hover.

![Superflat screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/foreverwelearn/obsidian-superflat/HEAD/imgs/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Superflat"
    author: "foreverwelearn"
    repo:   "foreverwelearn/obsidian-superflat"
    slug:   "superflat"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/superflat"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/foreverwelearn/obsidian-superflat"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/foreverwelearn/obsidian-superflat/HEAD/imgs/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Strip away UI clutter for a distraction-free workspace. Hide borders, scrollbars, and visual depth, revealing status bars, sidebars, and tab headers only on hover."
}
```
